syllabus.details: The notification gives a detailed syllabus. The 40-mark Sports-Related Information section covers these ten areas: | Exercise Physiology (energy systems, ATP production, cardiovascular and muscular adaptations, recovery and fatigue management) Sports Psychology (motivation, personality and sports performance, managing fear, anger, anxiety, aggression and stress) Sports Training (principles of training, training components, planning and periodization, talent identification) Sports Biomechanics (motion, force, levers, Newton's laws in sports, kinematics and kinetics, injury prevention) Sports Nutrition and Yoga (macronutrients, micronutrients, hydration, diet planning for athletes, balanced diet, yogic practices) Sports Medicine (common sports injuries, first aid and emergency care, massage and rehabilitation) Organization and Administration in Sports (sports organization, event management, facility and equipment management, leadership and communication) Testing, Measurement and Evaluation (physical fitness testing, skill and performance testing, body types) Application of Digital Learning and AI in Sports (digital coaching tools, AI applications, data management and statistical analysis, computer applications) International and National sports federations and bodies, major competitions, sports awards in India, and rules and regulations of sports | Part-2 covers computer and IT basics (hardware and software, input and output, IP address, IT gadgets, e-mail, printer, tablet and mobile operation, MS-Word and MS-Excel, operating systems, social networking, e-governance), digital financial tools, future skills and cyber security, and developments such as AI, big data processing, deep learning, machine learning and Internet of Things. Part-3 covers the history, culture, art, architecture, festivals, geography, economy, polity and current events of Uttar Pradesh. The remaining Part-1 subjects follow standard general studies topics as printed in the notification.

how_to_apply: The notification allows only the online application system. Applications sent by any other means are not accepted. Candidates should read the full advertisement before applying.

Visit the Commission's website upsssc.gov.in and, on the homepage under the Live Advertisement Segment, click the advertisement for Sports Directorate Main Examination (PET-2025)/22 to view or download it.
Log in using your PET-2025 registration number. An OTP is sent to the mobile number or e-mail registered in PET-2025.

Your personal details recorded in PET-2025 (name, parents' names, domicile, category, EWS, horizontal reservation details, date of birth, gender, marital status, mobile number, e-mail) are displayed automatically.
Select the posts you want to apply for. A post not selected is not considered.

For each selected post, choose Yes or No for the required educational qualification and enter the board or university name, year of passing, certificate or roll number, certificate issue date and marks details.

Check the photo and signature uploaded in PET-2025, which are displayed automatically and cannot be changed. Then enter whether you hold any preferential qualification, and check your permanent and correspondence address.
Read the declaration, tick all checkboxes, enter the verification code and click "Save and Submit".
Pay the fee through credit card, debit card, internet banking, UPI or SBI e-challan. The application is submitted automatically once the fee is paid and reconciled.
Download and print the application. Keep a copy safe, as it may be required during record verification.

If the application does not appear after payment, the fee has not been reconciled. Log in with the registration number, use "Update Your Transaction ID by Double Verification" in the Applicant Segment, and click "Verify Transaction ID".
If payment fails, a Payment Acknowledgment Receipt (PAR) appears instead of the application. Use the same option and then the "Application Fee Deposition" option to pay.
For SBI e-challan, download the challan, pay at any SBI branch, then enter the challan details through the "Update Your Transaction ID by Double Verification" option.

After the application is finally submitted, candidates can make corrections until 11-11-2026 by logging in through the Applicant's Dashboard, clicking "Modify Application" and entering the verification code and OTP. Only the following details can be corrected:
Personal details such as EWS and horizontal reservation category (Dependant of Freedom Fighter, Disabled, Ex-Servicemen, Gender, Outstanding Sportsperson, etc.).
Details of mandatory or preferential qualification entered in the application.
No correction is possible after the last date for correction, and the Commission does not accept separate representations for corrections.
important_instructions: Uttar Pradesh reserved-category candidates must mark their category in the application. Candidates working in central or state government service must get a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer, to be shown when the Commission asks. Self-attested copies of mark sheets, certificates and degrees must be produced to verify age and qualification when requested. The examination date, time and centre are given in the admission card. The centre, date and time are not changed in any case, and candidates should not write to the Commission about it. The Commission does not correspond individually with candidates. All information is uploaded on its website, so candidates should check it regularly. An application can be cancelled if the date of birth is not given, the candidate is overage or underage, lacks the mandatory qualification, or gives false information. Giving wrong facts that cannot be proved by certificates can lead to debarment from this and all other examinations and selections of the Commission. Malpractice, indiscipline or misbehaviour in the examination can lead to cancellation of candidature and debarment. The Uttar Pradesh Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024 applies.

The notification also lists these general conditions: Applicants must be citizens of India. Candidates must hold the mandatory educational qualification and other required eligibility, with the relevant certificates, by the last date of application, 04-11-2026. Candidates for the Main Examination are shortlisted on the normalized score of PET-2025. Candidates with zero, negative or less-than-zero absolute or normalized score are not shortlisted. Candidates whose PET-2025 results are marked "Under Investigation (UI)" or "Provisional" are allowed to apply provisionally. Their shortlisting and selection depend on the outcome of the Commission's inquiry. Only one application is to be submitted for the advertised posts. If more than one is submitted, the last submitted application is accepted and the others are treated as cancelled. Candidates must check that they meet the eligibility conditions before applying. The Commission does not advise candidates on their eligibility. Male candidates with more than one living wife, and female candidates married to a man who already has a living wife, are not considered eligible unless the Governor has granted an exemption.

content_sections.heading: Reservation Provisions in UPSSSC Sports Directorate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Reservation applies to Uttar Pradesh SC, ST, OBC and EWS candidates as per the latest Uttar Pradesh government orders and the requisition received from the department. EWS candidates must have family income from all sources below Rs. 8 lakh in the financial year before the year of application and must meet the conditions of the Uttar Pradesh Public Services (Reservation for Economically Weaker Sections) Act, 2020 (10 percent reservation). They need an EWS certificate issued between 01-04-2026 and 04-11-2026, based on FY 2025-26 income and valid for FY 2026-27, in the prescribed format. Candidates who are not original residents of Uttar Pradesh do not get reservation and are treated as Unreserved. A candidate claiming more than one reservation gets only one benefit, whichever is more beneficial. Ex-Servicemen must have retired from service by 04-11-2026. Dependants of Freedom Fighters and Ex-Servicemen get reservation under the Uttar Pradesh Public Services (Physically Handicapped, Dependants of Freedom Fighters and Ex-Servicemen) Reservation Act, 1993, as amended. Women of Uttar Pradesh are placed in the categories to which they belong. For Uttar Pradesh women candidates, only a caste certificate issued on the father's side is valid. Women's reservation is subject to the final decision of the Supreme Court in Special Appeal (D) No. 475/2019. Uttar Pradesh Outstanding Sportspersons must submit a certificate in the format prescribed by the competent authority, under the Uttar Pradesh Government Departments (Direct Recruitment to Group-C Posts of Outstanding Sportspersons) Rules, 2022. Persons with disabilities must hold a disability certificate issued by the competent authority in the prescribed format, stating the type and percentage of disability. The notification says posts have been re-identified to ensure 4 percent horizontal reservation, and disabled candidates must update their disability category and sub-category in the application. Candidates selected under horizontal reservation are adjusted in their own category. The notification attaches formats for the SC/ST caste certificate, OBC caste certificate, EWS income and asset certificate and self-declaration, dependant of freedom fighter certificate, and disability certificate forms (Appendix 1 to 9 and Annexure 1 to 2).
